front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Profile for BRSKI Bootstrapping
front.workgroup: Autonomic Networking Integrated Model and Approach

abstract.t: This document defines a post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) profile for the Bootstrapping Remote Secure Key Infrastructure (BRSKI) protocol and its constrained variant (cBRSKI). The profile specifies ML-DSA-signed vouchers, PQC pledge identity certificates, hybrid TLS during bootstrap exchanges, and a rotation-epoch-aware Manufacturer Authorized Signing Authority (MASA).

The profile is targeted at Internet-of-Things (IoT) and constrained-device deployments that require strong onboarding guarantees in the post-quantum era. Concrete device-class selection parameters are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: BRSKI enables zero-touch onboarding of devices into an operator's network. As deployments migrate to PQC, both vouchers and pledge identities must be expressible in PQC algorithms. This document defines the necessary profile.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: PQC Voucher Signing
section.t: MASAs compliant with this profile MUST be able to sign vouchers using ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 and MUST include the pqc_epoch_id field in the voucher.

section.name: PQC Pledge Identity Certificates
section.t: Pledge identity certificates MUST be either pure PQC or hybrid composite certificates conformant with the relevant LAMPS specifications.

section.name: Hybrid TLS During Bootstrap
section.t: Bootstrap exchanges MUST use TLS 1.3 with a hybrid key exchange selected from the PQC-approved set. Pure classical exchanges MUST be rejected when the profile is active.

section.name: Constrained-Device Considerations
section.t: For cBRSKI deployments, devices with insufficient resources to perform ML-DSA verification MAY fall back to SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s under operator policy. Concrete device-class selection parameters are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The profile preserves the BRSKI trust model while raising the cryptographic strength of the artifacts. Operators MUST monitor the freshness of pqc_epoch_id values across deployed pledges.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to allocate algorithm identifiers and voucher field identifiers necessary for this profile.
